name: No Body To Go With
source:
You are a sad, poorly drawn ghost. You want to go to the Spooky Ball, but you have nobody to go with!!!

A very short game, might take you five minutes.

[From [url=https://ubagub.itch.io/no-body-to-go-with]itch.io[/url]]
